name: Southwark Campus Resilience Study
subtitle: A public-data study around London South Bank University; no institutional partnership is claimed.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Southwark study geometry
notes: Coordinates are x east / z south metres around the study center.
Mapped building levels use an assumed 3 m per level; absent heights use an assumed 10 m.
15 original inner rings are retained and deducted from roof catchment area (3323.16 m²). 1 duplicate parent/member roof representation removed.
0 incomplete inner and 6 incomplete outer rings could not be normalized; no synthetic closures were added.
Paths and public street centerlines share exact original OSM node IDs. No synthetic road-crossing connectors were added.
Public street centerlines are pedestrian-access proxies, not a complete sidewalk or verified crossing/accessibility survey.
POIs attach to their nearest mapped graph node; final entrances and access require a survey.
Six shade-sail sites are conceptual, unsurveyed placements near mapped routes; feasibility is not established.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap mapped tree points — partial inventory
notes: Actual mapped natural=tree nodes, not a complete canopy survey.
The 2025 GLA full CSV download did not complete within its bounded timeout; this explicitly identified OSM layer is the available fallback.
Absent crown dimensions use an assumed 6 m diameter; absent heights use an assumed 10 m. Original tree tags are retained.
Recorded geometric dimensions do not establish current health, foliage density, or complete shade coverage.
